name: AutoHotkey Global Hotkeys
description: Exclusive-hotkey backend for AutoHotkey Linux Wayland sessions. Thin broker only: registers accelerators through Meta.Display.grab_accelerator + Main.wm.allowKeybinding and relays Activations/Deactivations to AHK over the session bus, directed to the registering owner. It never parses AHK, never executes commands and never forks. Verified on GNOME 49; versions 45-50 are declared from the stable API surface and load with a runtime warning when unverified.
